# GreenPulse Wellness

> Commercial recovery, rehabilitation, and longevity equipment and space architecture in India. We curate, import, install, and service medical-grade and performance wellness hardware for commercial wellness centres, luxury hotel spas, athletic clubs, physiotherapy clinics, hospitals, and private residences.

---

## What We Do

GreenPulse Wellness provides turnkey recovery infrastructure:
1. **Curated Global Hardware**: Importation of certified recovery, contrast, photobiomodulation, hyperbaric, compression, and biomechanical rehabilitation equipment.
2. **Space Planning & 3D Architectural Architecture**: Floor layouts, zoning, ventilation, electrical load sizing, plumbing/drainage, and acoustic isolation for commercial facilities.
3. **White-Glove Commissioning**: On-site mechanical installation, calibration, electrical verification, and operator staff training.
4. **Biomedical AMC & Service**: Preventive maintenance contracts, filter/bulb replacements, rapid-response technician dispatch, and loaner units for clinical continuity.
5. **Flexible Procurement**: Direct capital purchase (CapEx), operational equipment leasing, and month-to-month clinical rentals for post-op and home convalescence.

---

## 4 Core Spatial Solutions

We design and equip spaces across 4 distinct functional models:

### 1. Recover & Restore (Contrast & Thermal Sanctuaries)
- **URL**: https://greenpulsewellness.com/solutions/recover
- **Focus**: High-throughput contrast therapy, thermal vascular pumping, and cellular recovery.
- **Target Audience**: Wellness & longevity centres, luxury hotel spas, fitness clubs, and private estates.
- **Typical Footprint**: 450–1,200 sq.ft.
- **Core Modalities**: Full-spectrum infrared saunas (far, mid, near IR), commercial cold plunges with ozone and sub-micron filtration (down to 3°C), whole-body cryotherapy cabins (-110°C to -140°C), and zero-gravity contrast loungers.

### 2. AgeWell (Cellular Vitality & Preventive Longevity)
- **URL**: https://greenpulsewellness.com/solutions/agewell
- **Focus**: Mitochondrial activation, tissue oxygenation, and systemic anti-inflammatory optimization.
- **Target Audience**: Longevity clinics, executive health suites, premium integrative wellness facilities, and private longevity residences.
- **Typical Footprint**: 500–1,500 sq.ft.
- **Core Modalities**: Hard-shell mild hyperbaric oxygen chambers (1.3 to 2.0 ATA, 93%+ O2 purity), clinical full-body photobiomodulation (PBM) LED beds (660nm red & 850nm near-infrared wavelengths), and targeted cellular recovery systems.

### 3. Rehabilitate (Physical Therapy & Biomechanical Restoration)
- **URL**: https://greenpulsewellness.com/solutions/rehabilitate
- **Focus**: Musculoskeletal injury recovery, neuromuscular re-education, and spinal decompressive therapy.
- **Target Audience**: Orthopaedic hospitals, sports medicine institutes, physical therapy clinics, and elite athletic performance training facilities.
- **Typical Footprint**: 600–2,000 sq.ft.
- **Core Modalities**: Multi-drop electric chiropractic tables, 4D robotic spinal decompression massage loungers, motorized rehabilitation treatment couches, and clinical percussion units.

### 4. Live Well (Clinical Care & Home Convalescence)
- **URL**: https://greenpulsewellness.com/solutions/live-well
- **Focus**: Bridging the critical gap between inpatient hospital discharge and comfortable home recovery.
- **Target Audience**: Post-operative surgical recovery clinics, specialized assisted living, palliative homecare, and private patient suites.
- **Typical Footprint**: 120–400 sq.ft (per patient room/suite).
- **Core Modalities**: Zero-gravity therapeutic positioning chairs, localized cold compression therapy, lightweight foldable power wheelchairs, and flexible month-to-month rental equipment.

## Complete Hardware Catalog by Modality

Catalog Index: https://greenpulsewellness.com/products

### 1. Infrared Saunas & Heat Therapy
- **Infrared Sauna Single Full-Spectrum (MStar)** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/infrared-sauna-single-full-spectrum-mstar): Canadian hemlock / cedar wood, near/mid/far infrared emitters, chromotherapy, low-EMF shielding (<2 mG).

- **Infrared Sauna Group Full-Spectrum (MStar)** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/infrared-sauna-group-full-spectrum-mstar): 4-to-6 person commercial cabin for hotels and athletic clubs.
- **Infrared Sauna Combination Suites (MStar)** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/infrared-sauna-double-combination-mstar): Hybrid traditional Finnish rock stove + full-spectrum infrared heating.
- **Sauna Blanket RL301** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/sauna-blanket-rl301): Portable far-infrared thermal wrap for private treatment rooms and travel.

### 2. Cold Water Immersion & Cryotherapy
- **Cold Plunge Single Round (YG)** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/cold-plunge-single-round-yg): Insulated stainless steel tub, 1.0 HP chiller with heating/cooling (3°C to 40°C), ozone sanitation, 20-micron filtration.
- **Cold Plunge Tub Commercial Ice Bath** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/cold-plunge-tub-new-ice-bath): High-throughput commercial plunge for gyms and spas with continuous filtration.
- **Cold Plunge Foldable AirCore** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/cold-plunge-foldable-aircore): Drop-stitch military-grade PVC inflatable tub with external quick-connect chiller.
- **Cryo Mini (CryoMe)** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/cryo-mini-cryome): Localized sub-zero cryogenic therapy for targeted joint inflammation and facial cryo-stimulation.
- **Cold Therapy Compression Unit 806Pro & CL802** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/cold-therapy-unit-806pro): Continuous chilled water circulation paired with pneumatic compression for acute post-surgical swelling.

### 3. Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (mHBOT)
- **HBOT Single Cube Chamber** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/hbot-single-cube-chamber): Hard-shell mild hyperbaric chamber operating at 1.3 to 1.5 ATA with dedicated medical-grade oxygen concentrator (93%–96% purity).
- **HBOT Double Cube Chamber** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/hbot-double-cube-chamber): Dual-occupancy spacious chamber for assisted sessions, executive clinics, and private spas.
- **HBOT Single Mini (Komjet)** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/hbot-single-mini-komjet): Compact hard/soft hybrid chamber optimized for home recovery and boutique clinics.

### 4. Photobiomodulation (PBM / Red Light Therapy)
- **LED Therapy Full-Body Clam Bed (M6 & M6L)** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/led-therapy-full-body-clam-1-m6): 360-degree full-body immersion canopy, dual wavelengths (660nm red + 850nm near-infrared), multi-frequency pulsing (10Hz–40Hz).
- **LED Therapy Full Stand Chamber** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/led-therapy-full-stand-chamber): Upright vertical photobiomodulation panel array for quick 10-minute sessions in gyms.
- **Targeted LED Panels & Lamps** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/led-stand-gy-t320): Modular clinic-grade panels for targeted tendon, joint, and facial tissue regeneration.
- **Red Light Blanket RL302** (https://greenpulsewellness.com/products/red-light-blanket-rl302): Flexible wearable 660/850nm LED blanket for in-bed rehabilitation.

### 5. Compression Therapy & Lymphatic Recovery

### 6. Robotic 4D Massage & Spinal Decompression

## Research & Evidence-Based Insights (The Journal)

Journal Index: https://greenpulsewellness.com/blog

1. **The Science of Photobiomodulation in Infrared Saunas**
   - URL: https://greenpulsewellness.com/blog/science-of-photobiomodulation-infrared-saunas
   - Key finding: 660nm and 850nm wavelengths trigger cytochrome c oxidase in mitochondrial respiration, elevating cellular ATP synthesis by 140–200%.
2. **Designing Commercial Recovery Suites for Luxury Hotels**
   - URL: https://greenpulsewellness.com/blog/designing-commercial-recovery-suites-for-luxury-hotels
   - Key finding: High-yield wellness suites generate 25–40% RevPAR premiums by converting underutilized square footage into private contrast suites.
3. **Mild Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (mHBOT): The Operator's Clinical Guide**
   - URL: https://greenpulsewellness.com/blog/mild-hyperbaric-oxygen-therapy-recovery-guide
   - Key finding: 1.3 to 1.5 ATA pressure increases plasma dissolved oxygen independently of haemoglobin, promoting capillary neoangiogenesis.
4. **Contrast Therapy Protocols: Infrared Hyperthermia and Sub-5°C Cold Water Immersion**
   - URL: https://greenpulsewellness.com/blog/contrast-therapy-infrared-cold-water-immersion
   - Key finding: Alternating vasodilation (sauna) and vasoconstriction (ice bath) stimulates the autonomic vascular pump and down-regulates systemic inflammatory markers.
5. **Dynamic Sequential Compression for Athletic Recovery**
   - URL: https://greenpulsewellness.com/blog/dynamic-compression-for-athletic-recovery-normatec
   - Key finding: Peristaltic pneumatic gradient pulsing accelerates venous-lymphatic return and reduces post-exercise delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS).
6. **Wellness Hardware ROI: Monetization Strategies for Gyms, Spas & Clinics**
   - URL: https://greenpulsewellness.com/blog/wellness-roi-how-gyms-and-spas-monetize-recovery-tech
   - Key finding: Turnkey passive recovery hardware achieves commercial payback within 6 to 14 months at 65% average utilization.

## Compliance, Safety & Governance

- **Wellness Classification**: GreenPulse Wellness equipment is commercial recovery, lifestyle, and rehabilitation wellness technology. We enforce strict wellness-only language ("supports cellular recovery", "promotes restorative relaxation") and never make disease-cure or diagnostic medical claims.
- **Electrical & Engineering Standards**: All hardware complies with CE, ISO 9001/13485, and RoHS directives with dedicated earth grounding, surge suppression, and low-EMF shielding.
- **Water & Air Sanitation**: Plunge systems utilize dual ozone oxidation and sub-micron continuous filtration; hyperbarics utilize dual-stage HEPA air filtration.
- **Policies**:
  - Regulatory Compliance & Safety: https://greenpulsewellness.com/compliance
  - Privacy Policy: https://greenpulsewellness.com/privacy
  - Terms of Service: https://greenpulsewellness.com/terms
  - Grievance Redressal: https://greenpulsewellness.com/complaints
  - Cookie Policy: https://greenpulsewellness.com/cookies
